# `storage/CacheDriver.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/storage/CacheDriver.js`

CacheDriver.js — Cache API wrapper for rebuildable assets. Used for content that can always be re-downloaded/rebuilt: - CDN assets and web dependencies - Downloaded package chunks (sha256-keyed) - App bundles and compiled shaders - Prefetched update manifests Keys are URLs or opaque cache keys like "chunk:sha256-abc123". All methods are async.
